_readme: Training content for the results page. Edit names, sets and cues freely.
type: 'main' (big lift: 5–8 reps for performance goals), 'accessory', or 'core' (uses coreReps instead of the goal's rep range).
perSide: true adds 'each side' to the reps.
cues: 2–3 short form tips, shown under each exercise in a 'Form tips' dropdown.
home: the dumbbell/bodyweight swap used when 'Training at home?' is switched on (needs name and cues).

finisher.title: 5-minute finisher
finisher.text: Every minute for 5 minutes: 10 bodyweight squats + 20 mountain climbers. Rest for whatever is left of the minute.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
cues: Hold the dumbbell at your chest, elbows tucked.
Sit between your hips, knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your whole foot and stand tall.

home.name: Dumbbell Squat
cues: Dumbbells at your sides, chest proud.
Sit back and down until thighs are near parallel.
Push the floor away to stand.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Shoulder blades squeezed back and down.
Lower the dumbbells to mid-chest with elbows at about 45°.
Press up and slightly in, without clanking the weights.

home.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
cues: Lie on the floor, knees bent.
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause, then press straight up.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
cues: Sit tall with a slight bend in your knees.
Pull the handle to your belly button.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then return with control.

home.name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
cues: Hinge forward with a flat back.
Row the dumbbells toward your hips.
Lower slowly, feeling the stretch in your back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Soft knees, push your hips back.
Keep the dumbbells close to your legs.
Stop when you feel your hamstrings stretch, then squeeze your glutes to stand.

home.name: Single-Leg Dumbbell RDL
cues: Stand on one leg, slight knee bend.
Hinge forward as the back leg lifts behind you.
Keep your hips square and return slowly.

exercises.name: Plank
cues: Elbows under your shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Straight line from head to heels, no sagging.

home.name: Plank Shoulder Taps
cues: High plank, feet a little wider than hips.
Tap the opposite shoulder without rocking your hips.
Move slowly and breathe.

exercises.name: Leg Press
cues: Feet shoulder-width, mid-platform.
Lower until your knees reach about 90°.
Press through your heels without locking your knees.

home.name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
cues: Wide stance, toes turned out.
Hold one dumbbell between your legs.
Sit straight down and drive up through your heels.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
cues: Grip just wider than your shoulders.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, leading with your elbows.
Control it all the way back up.

home.name: Dumbbell Pullover
cues: Lie on a bench or the floor, one dumbbell over your chest.
Lower it behind your head with slightly bent arms.
Pull it back over your chest using your lats.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cues: Dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward.
Brace your core and don't arch your lower back.
Press overhead until your arms are straight.

home.name: Half-Kneeling Dumbbell Press
cues: Kneel on one knee, squeeze that glute.
Press one dumbbell overhead.
Keep your ribs down and your body still.

exercises.name: Walking Lunges
cues: Take a long step, keeping your torso tall.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front heel into the next step.

home.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
cues: Step back and lower your back knee.
Keep most of your weight in your front heel.
Drive back up to standing.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
cues: Press your lower back into the floor.
Extend your opposite arm and leg slowly.
Exhale as you reach, then switch sides.

home.name: Bird Dog
cues: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Reach your opposite arm and leg long.
Hold for a second without twisting.

days.focus: Full body: single-leg, upper chest, glutes

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step-Ups
cues: Whole foot on a knee-height box.
Drive through your front heel to stand tall.
Lower slowly, don't drop down.

home.name: Bodyweight Step-Up
cues: Use a sturdy step or stair.
Push through the top foot, not the bottom one.
Control the way down.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
cues: Set the bench to about 30°.
Lower the dumbbells to your upper chest.
Press up and slightly together.

home.name: Incline Push-Up
cues: Hands on a bench, couch or counter.
Body in one straight line.
Lower your chest to the edge, then push away.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
cues: Chest on an incline bench, feet planted.
Row your elbows back toward your hips.
Pause and squeeze at the top.

home.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
cues: One hand and knee on a bench or chair.
Pull the dumbbell to your hip.
Keep your shoulders level.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
cues: Feet flat, hip-width apart.
Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top, ribs down.

home.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
cues: One foot planted, the other leg straight.
Push through the planted heel.
Keep your hips level.

exercises.name: Side Plank
cues: Elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Hold without letting your hips drop.

home.name: Side Plank Hip Dips
cues: Start in a side plank.
Lower your hip a few inches, then lift.
Move slowly and with control.

finisher.title: 5-minute finisher
finisher.text: 5 rounds: 30 seconds of dumbbell thrusters, then 30 seconds of rest. Pick a weight you can move fast.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
cues: Bar on your upper back, grip tight.
Brace, then sit down between your hips.
Drive up with your chest and hips rising together.

home.name: Double-Dumbbell Front Squat
cues: Dumbbells on your shoulders, elbows up.
Squat to at least parallel.
Stay tall and drive up through your midfoot.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
cues: Eyes under the bar, shoulder blades pinned.
Lower to your lower chest with control.
Press back up in a slight arc over your shoulders.

home.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
cues: Lie on the floor, knees bent.
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause, then press straight up.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
cues: Hinge to about 45°, back flat.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs.
Lower with control, no jerking.

home.name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
cues: Hinge forward with a flat back.
Row the dumbbells toward your hips.
Lower slowly, feeling the stretch in your back.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
cues: Bar close to your legs, soft knees.
Push your hips back until your hamstrings are loaded.
Squeeze your glutes to stand, without leaning back.

home.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Soft knees, push your hips back.
Keep the dumbbells close to your legs.
Stand by squeezing your glutes.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
cues: Hang with active shoulders.
Curl your knees toward your chest.
Lower slowly, no swinging.

home.name: Lying Leg Raise
cues: Lower back pressed into the floor.
Lower your legs as far as you can with your back flat.
Raise them back up with control.

exercises.name: Deadlift
cues: Bar over your midfoot, shins close.
Brace hard and pull the slack out of the bar.
Push the floor away and lock out with your glutes.

home.name: Dumbbell Deadlift
cues: Dumbbells at your sides.
Hinge and bend your knees until the weights reach mid-shin.
Stand up tall, squeezing your glutes.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
cues: Grip just outside your shoulders, glutes tight.
Press the bar straight up, moving your head out of the way.
Finish with the bar over your midfoot.

home.name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cues: Dumbbells at shoulder height.
Brace and press overhead.
Don't lean back.

exercises.name: Pull-Ups
cues: Start from a full hang.
Pull your chest toward the bar, elbows down.
Lower all the way under control. Use a band if needed.

home.name: Dumbbell Pullover
cues: Lie on a bench or the floor, one dumbbell over your chest.
Lower it behind your head with slightly bent arms.
Pull it back over your chest using your lats.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
cues: Rear foot on a bench, front foot well forward.
Lower straight down.
Drive through your front heel.

home.name: Couch Split Squat
cues: Rear foot on the couch or a chair.
Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Lower slowly, then stand through your front heel.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
cues: Kneel holding the rope by your head.
Crunch your ribs toward your hips.
Keep your hips still.

home.name: Weighted Crunch
cues: Hold a dumbbell on your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Lower slowly.

days.focus: Front squat, upper chest, glutes, carry

exercises.name: Front Squat
cues: Bar on your front shoulders, elbows high.
Sit straight down, chest up.
Drive up without letting your elbows drop.

home.name: Dumbbell Front Squat
cues: Dumbbells on your shoulders, elbows high.
Squat to at least parallel.
Stay tall as you drive up.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
cues: Set the bench to about 30°.
Lower the dumbbells to your upper chest.
Press up and slightly together.

home.name: Feet-Elevated Push-Up
cues: Feet on a couch or step, hands on the floor.
Body in one straight line.
Lower your chest to the floor, then press away.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
cues: One hand and knee on a bench.
Pull the dumbbell to your hip.
Keep your shoulders level.

home.name: Renegade Row
cues: High plank on two dumbbells.
Row one side without rotating your hips.
Alternate sides with control.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
cues: Upper back on the bench, bar over your hips.
Drive your hips up until your body is flat.
Tuck your chin and squeeze your glutes at the top.

home.name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
cues: Shoulders on the couch, dumbbell on your hips.
Drive up until your hips are level.
Pause and squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
cues: Heavy dumbbells at your sides.
Stand tall, shoulders back.
Walk with short, steady steps.

home.name: Suitcase Carry
cues: One heavy dumbbell in one hand.
Stay upright and don't lean.
Switch hands halfway.
